blocks.zh: 第六部分：隔離器系統 Amendment 1 | 第七部分：替代製程（醫療器材及組合產品）
blocks.en: Part 6: Isolator Systems, Amendment 1 | Part 7: Alternative Processes (Medical Devices and Combination Products)

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解隔離器（Isolator）系統在無菌製程中的定義、類型及與傳統 RABS 系統的根本差異
blocks.en: Understand the definition and types of isolator systems in aseptic processing, and how they fundamentally differ from conventional RABS

blocks.zh: 掌握隔離器的生物去污染（Bio-Decontamination）過程：汽化過氧化氫（VHP/HPV）的驗證要求
blocks.en: Master the bio-decontamination process of isolators: validation requirements for vaporized hydrogen peroxide (VHP/HPV)

blocks.zh: 學習隔離器的資格確認框架及其對周圍環境等級要求的影響（可降至 Grade C/D）
blocks.en: Learn the qualification framework for isolators and its effect on the classification required of the surrounding environment (can be lowered to Grade C/D)

blocks.zh: 理解 ISO 13408-7 的適用範圍：傳統培地充填不可行時的替代製程模擬策略
blocks.en: Understand the scope of ISO 13408-7: alternative process simulation strategies when conventional media fill is not feasible

blocks.zh: 掌握風險評估在替代製程模擬設計中的關鍵作用及代用品（Surrogate）使用標準
blocks.en: Master the key role of risk assessment in designing alternative process simulations, and the criteria for using surrogates

blocks.zh: ISO 13408-6 (Part 6) — Isolator Systems: Key Concepts and Amendment 1 Updates ISO 13408-6 (Part 6) — 隔離器系統：關鍵概念與修正案 1 更新
blocks.en: ISO 13408-6 (Part 6) — Isolator Systems: Key Concepts and Amendment 1 Updates

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：太空站 vs 無塵室
blocks.en: Analogy: space station vs cleanroom

blocks.zh: 隔離器就像太空站：太空站內部與惡劣的外太空完全隔離（物理屏障），可以在相對惡劣的外部環境中維持內部的高度控制。RABS 就像一個有安全門禁的無塵室——有限制，但不是完全封閉的太空站。要「進入」太空站，你需要通過複雜的氣閘程序（類似隔離器的 RTP 傳遞口），而不能直接打開門走進去。
blocks.en: An isolator is like a space station: the interior is completely separated from the harsh environment of outer space (a physical barrier), so a high degree of control can be maintained inside even when the outside is relatively poor. RABS is like a cleanroom with a secured entry door: it has restrictions, but it is not a fully enclosed space station. To "enter" the space station you must go through a complex airlock procedure (similar to the RTP transfer port of an isolator); you cannot simply open the door and walk in.

blocks.zh: VHP 去污染驗證要求
blocks.en: VHP decontamination validation requirements

blocks.zh: 汽化過氧化氫（VHP / HPV）是隔離器的標準生物去污染方法。其驗證必須包括：
blocks.en: Vaporized hydrogen peroxide (VHP/HPV) is the standard bio-decontamination method for isolators. Its validation must include:

blocks.zh: 生物指示劑（BI）挑戰：G. stearothermophilus 孢子（10⁶ CFU），放置於隔離器內部最難到達的位置（最差條件）
blocks.en: Biological indicator (BI) challenge: G. stearothermophilus spores (10⁶ CFU) placed at the hardest-to-reach locations inside the isolator (worst case)

blocks.zh: VHP 濃度監測：確認整個腔室的 VHP 濃度分布均勻
blocks.en: VHP concentration monitoring: confirm that the VHP concentration is evenly distributed throughout the chamber

blocks.zh: 脫附殘留評估：VHP 去污染後，確認過氧化氫殘留降至可接受水平（對產品和操作員安全）
blocks.en: Desorption and residue assessment: after VHP decontamination, confirm that hydrogen peroxide residues fall to an acceptable level (for both product and operator safety)

blocks.zh: 物料相容性：確認常用的過濾器、管路、容器材料能耐受 VHP 循環
blocks.en: Material compatibility: confirm that commonly used filters, tubing and container materials can withstand the VHP cycle

blocks.zh: Amendment 1 特別加入了「人員暴露限值」要求，反映了對操作員安全的重視。
blocks.en: Amendment 1 specifically adds a "personnel exposure limit" requirement, reflecting the emphasis on operator safety.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：隔離器在 CDMO 的商業邏輯
blocks.en: Practical application: the business logic of isolators at a CDMO

blocks.zh: 隔離器的 CapEx 比傳統 Grade A/B 潔淨室高，但 OpEx 更低，因為：
blocks.en: An isolator has a higher CapEx than a conventional Grade A/B cleanroom, but a lower OpEx, because:

blocks.zh: 環境監測簡化：Grade C 的隔離器周圍環境 EM 要求比 Grade B 少得多
blocks.en: Simplified environmental monitoring: the EM requirements for the Grade C environment around an isolator are much lighter than for Grade B

blocks.zh: 更衣程序簡化：操作員不需要穿戴完整的 Grade A 無菌服（只需 Grade C 配備）
blocks.en: Simplified gowning: operators do not need full Grade A sterile gowning (Grade C attire is enough)

blocks.zh: 培地充填頻率可能降低：某些監管機構（特別是 EU GMP）認可隔離器的人員污染風險更低，可能允許較低頻率的 APS（需要充分論據）
blocks.en: Media fill frequency may be reduced: some regulators (EU GMP in particular) recognize that isolators carry a lower risk of contamination from personnel, and may allow a lower APS frequency (with a sound justification)

blocks.zh: 產品交叉污染風險降低：完全封閉的環境有助於 CDMO 接受更多種類的活性藥物（HPAPI、ADC）
blocks.en: Lower risk of product cross-contamination: the fully enclosed environment helps a CDMO accept a wider range of active drugs (HPAPI, ADC)

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一個新建隔離器安裝後，需要進行首次 VHP 去污染驗證。請描述 BI 放置策略：哪些位置是「最差條件」？放置多少個 BI？
blocks.en: A newly installed isolator needs its first VHP decontamination validation. Describe your BI placement strategy: which locations are the "worst case"? How many BIs would you place?

blocks.zh: 隔離器手套在每班使用前應進行什麼檢查？如果發現手套有微小破損，應採取什麼行動？這個破損是否影響之前已完成的充填？
blocks.en: What checks should be performed on isolator gloves before each shift? If a small defect is found in a glove, what action should be taken? Does the defect affect fills already completed?

blocks.zh: 核心概念：隔離器 vs RABS — 根本差異
blocks.en: Core concept: isolator vs RABS — the fundamental difference

blocks.zh: 隔離器的優勢：將人員（最大污染源）與產品完全隔離，可降低周圍環境等級要求（節省設施建設和運行成本），潔淨室等級失控風險對產品影響更小。
blocks.en: Advantages of the isolator: it completely separates personnel (the biggest source of contamination) from the product, which allows a lower classification of the surrounding environment (saving facility construction and running costs) and means a loss of control of the cleanroom classification has less impact on the product.

blocks.zh: ISO 13408-7 (Part 7) — Alternative Processes for Medical Devices and Combination Products ISO 13408-7 (Part 7) — 醫療器材與組合產品的替代製程
blocks.en: ISO 13408-7 (Part 7) — Alternative Processes for Medical Devices and Combination Products

blocks.zh: 核心概念：Part 7 的存在理由
blocks.en: Core concept: why Part 7 exists

blocks.zh: ISO 13408-1 的傳統培地充填（Media Fill）假設：可以用液態培養基替換產品進行充填。但這對許多醫療器材和組合產品不適用，例如：
blocks.en: The conventional media fill of ISO 13408-1 assumes that liquid growth medium can be substituted for the product during filling. This does not work for many medical devices and combination products, for example:

blocks.zh: 預充填注射器組件：注射器、活塞、針頭的無菌組裝
blocks.en: Prefilled syringe components: aseptic assembly of syringes, plungers and needles

blocks.zh: 藥物+器材組合產品（Combination Products）：藥物洗脫支架、藥物塗層球囊
blocks.en: Drug + device combination products: drug-eluting stents, drug-coated balloons

blocks.zh: 固體醫療器材（Solid Medical Devices）：無菌骨科植入物、心臟瓣膜
blocks.en: Solid medical devices: sterile orthopedic implants, heart valves

blocks.zh: 生物製劑（如細胞治療）：產品本身就是生物材料，無法用培養基替代
blocks.en: Biologics (such as cell therapy): the product itself is biological material and cannot be replaced by growth medium

blocks.zh: ISO 13408-7 提供了一個框架：如何用風險評估設計替代的製程模擬策略。
blocks.en: ISO 13408-7 provides a framework for how to use risk assessment to design an alternative process simulation strategy.

blocks.zh: 重要要求：所有步驟必須被涵蓋
blocks.en: Key requirement: all steps must be covered

blocks.zh: ISO 13408-7 的核心原則之一：即使製程被分成多個子製程分別模擬，整體策略必須涵蓋全部無菌處理步驟。
blocks.en: One of the core principles of ISO 13408-7: even when the process is divided into several sub-processes that are simulated separately, the overall strategy must cover all aseptic processing steps.

blocks.zh: 這是防止「漏洞」的關鍵要求——不能因為某個步驟「難以模擬」就跳過它。如果直接替換培養基不可行，必須找到其他方式驗證那個步驟（如環境監測、人員監控、設備資格確認的組合）。
blocks.en: This is the key requirement that prevents "gaps": a step cannot be skipped because it is "difficult to simulate". If directly substituting growth medium is not feasible, another way must be found to validate that step (for example a combination of environmental monitoring, personnel monitoring and equipment qualification).

blocks.zh: 替代製程模擬策略設計框架
blocks.en: Framework for designing an alternative process simulation strategy

blocks.zh:
ISO 13408-7 製程模擬策略決策流程：

步驟 1：可否直接用液態培養基替換？
  是 → 按 ISO 13408-1 的 Media Fill 執行
  否 → 繼續步驟 2

步驟 2：可否在製程末尾（final closure 前）
         注入培養基至容器/無菌屏障？
  是 → 採用「末端培養基注入」方法
  否 → 繼續步驟 3

步驟 3：識別所有高風險步驟
  每個步驟需要：
  - 確定污染風險類型（人員接觸、環境暴露、設備接觸）
  - 選擇最合適的模擬/驗證方法：
    * 代用品（Surrogate）模擬
    * 環境監測強化
    * 人員行為觀察記錄
    * 特定步驟的局部培養基填充

步驟 4：確保所有步驟都被涵蓋
  → 完整記錄整個策略
  → 監管機構在審查時會特別關注「漏洞」
blocks.en:
ISO 13408-7 process simulation strategy decision flow:

Step 1: Can liquid growth medium directly replace the product?
  Yes → perform a media fill per ISO 13408-1
  No → go to Step 2

Step 2: Can growth medium be injected into the container/sterile barrier
         at the end of the process (before final closure)?
  Yes → use the "end-of-process medium injection" method
  No → go to Step 3

Step 3: Identify all high-risk steps
  For each step:
  - Determine the type of contamination risk (personnel contact, environmental exposure, equipment contact)
  - Select the most suitable simulation/validation method:
    * Surrogate simulation
    * Enhanced environmental monitoring
    * Documented observation of personnel behavior
    * Localized media fill of specific steps

Step 4: Ensure that all steps are covered
  → Document the entire strategy fully
  → Regulators will pay particular attention to "gaps" during review

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：模擬演習的替代方案
blocks.en: Analogy: the alternative to a drill

blocks.zh: 傳統 Media Fill 就像消防演習（直接替換產品）。但如果你生產的是一架「真實飛機」而非液體，你不能把飛機換成水來做測試。ISO 13408-7 就像是「飛行模擬器訓練」——你設計各種模擬情景（最難的操作步驟、緊急介入、最差環境條件），用最接近真實的方式（代用品或分步驗證）證明整個過程的無菌保證能力。
blocks.en: A conventional media fill is like a fire drill (directly substituting the product). But if you are building a real aircraft rather than a liquid, you cannot swap the aircraft for water to run the test. ISO 13408-7 is like "flight simulator training": you design a variety of scenarios (the hardest operating steps, emergency interventions, worst-case environmental conditions) and use the closest possible approximation to reality (surrogates or step-by-step validation) to demonstrate the sterility assurance capability of the whole process.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：組合產品 CDMO 的挑戰
blocks.en: Practical application: challenges for combination product CDMOs

blocks.zh: ISO 13408-7 對以下業務類型特別重要：
blocks.en: ISO 13408-7 is particularly important for the following types of business:

blocks.zh: 預充填注射器（PFS）裝配：針頭插入、活塞安裝等步驟可能需要替代模擬策略
blocks.en: Prefilled syringe (PFS) assembly: steps such as needle insertion and plunger placement may need an alternative simulation strategy

blocks.zh: 藥物塗層器材：塗層工藝後的無菌處理，可能無法直接注入培養基
blocks.en: Drug-coated devices: aseptic handling after the coating process, where it may not be possible to inject growth medium directly

blocks.zh: 細胞/基因治療產品：產品本身是生物材料，用培養基替換後整個「模擬」已不再代表真實製程
blocks.en: Cell/gene therapy products: the product itself is biological material, and once it is replaced by growth medium the whole "simulation" no longer represents the real process

blocks.zh: 植入式藥物輸送系統：如微型泵的無菌組裝
blocks.en: Implantable drug delivery systems: such as aseptic assembly of micropumps

blocks.zh: CDMO 承接此類業務時，需要在 CMC 開發早期就制定製程模擬策略，並與監管機構（FDA、EMA）進行前瞻性溝通（Pre-Sub Meeting / Scientific Advice），確認策略可被接受。
blocks.en: When a CDMO takes on this type of business, it needs to define the process simulation strategy early in CMC development and communicate proactively with regulators (FDA, EMA) (Pre-Sub Meeting / Scientific Advice) to confirm that the strategy will be accepted.

blocks.zh: 一個 CDMO 正在開發一款藥物洗脫心臟支架（Drug-Eluting Stent）的無菌組裝流程。由於支架本身是固體金屬器材，無法直接用培養基替換。請描述你會如何設計一個符合 ISO 13408-7 要求的製程模擬策略。
blocks.en: A CDMO is developing an aseptic assembly process for a drug-eluting stent. Because the stent is a solid metal device, it cannot be directly replaced by growth medium. Describe how you would design a process simulation strategy that complies with ISO 13408-7.

blocks.zh: ISO 13408-7 要求「在首批人體使用臨床產品生產之前」完成初始製程模擬。為什麼這個時間點很重要？如果因為時間壓力想在首批臨床生產後再補做，會有什麼風險？
blocks.en: ISO 13408-7 requires the initial process simulation to be completed "before the first production of clinical product for human use". Why is this timing important? If, under time pressure, you wanted to do it after the first clinical production, what risks would there be?

blocks.zh: ISO 13408-7 允許使用代用品（Surrogate）來模擬難以處理的產品。代用品必須滿足哪些條件才被認可？僅僅「形狀相似」是否足夠？
blocks.en: ISO 13408-7 allows surrogates to be used to simulate products that are difficult to handle. What conditions must a surrogate meet to be accepted? Is "similar shape" alone enough?

blocks.zh: ISO 13408 系列整合視野 — 從單一部分到完整無菌製程保證
blocks.en: Integrated view of the ISO 13408 series — from single parts to complete aseptic process assurance

blocks.zh: CDMO 無菌製造能力的完整建設路徑
blocks.en: The complete path to building CDMO aseptic manufacturing capability

blocks.zh: 一個 CDMO 要建立完整的無菌製造能力，需要按 ISO 13408 系列逐步建立：
blocks.en: A CDMO building a complete aseptic manufacturing capability needs to build it up step by step following the ISO 13408 series:

blocks.zh: 第一層：Part 1 — 建立 APD、風險管理框架、APA 設計
blocks.en: Layer 1: Part 1 — establish the APD, the risk management framework and the APA design

blocks.zh: 第二層：Parts 4+5 — 設備清洗和滅菌系統（CIP+SIP）驗證
blocks.en: Layer 2: Parts 4+5 — validation of equipment cleaning and sterilization systems (CIP+SIP)

blocks.zh: 第三層：Part 2 — 過濾驗證和日常完整性測試
blocks.en: Layer 3: Part 2 — filtration validation and routine integrity testing

blocks.zh: 第四層：Part 6（如適用） — 隔離器 VHP 驗證
blocks.en: Layer 4: Part 6 (if applicable) — isolator VHP validation

blocks.zh: 第五層：Part 3（如適用） — 凍乾機驗證
blocks.en: Layer 5: Part 3 (if applicable) — lyophilizer validation

blocks.zh: 整合驗證：APS（培地充填）整合測試整個系統
blocks.en: Integrated validation: APS (media fill) tests the entire system as a whole

blocks.zh: 每一層都建立在前一層的基礎上。CIP/SIP 是過濾的前提（清潔管路才能有效過濾），隔離器是 APS 的特殊版本（但仍需做 APS）。
blocks.en: Each layer builds on the one before. CIP/SIP is a prerequisite for filtration (filtration is only effective with clean piping), and the isolator is a special version of APS (but APS is still required).

blocks.zh: ISO 13408 系列的未來發展
blocks.en: Future development of the ISO 13408 series

blocks.zh: 截至 2026 年，ISO 13408 系列的現狀與發展方向：
blocks.en: The current status and direction of the ISO 13408 series as of 2026:

blocks.zh: Part 1：2008 版本（含 2013 Amendment 1），預計未來更新以更好對齊 EU GMP Annex 1:2022
blocks.en: Part 1: 2008 edition (including 2013 Amendment 1); a future update is expected to align better with EU GMP Annex 1:2022

blocks.zh: Part 2：2018 第二版已更新，納入 Mycoplasma 過濾和 PUPSIT
blocks.en: Part 2: second edition of 2018 has been updated to include Mycoplasma filtration and PUPSIT

blocks.zh: Part 6：2005 版本有 2013 Amendment，但主體框架仍基於 2005 年的技術
blocks.en: Part 6: the 2005 edition has a 2013 Amendment, but the main framework is still based on 2005 technology

blocks.zh: 整合趨勢：ISO TC 198 可能整合部分部分（如 Part 4+5），簡化系列結構
blocks.en: Integration trend: ISO TC 198 may merge some parts (such as Part 4+5) to simplify the structure of the series

blocks.zh: ISO 13408 系列完整學習總結
blocks.en: Complete learning summary of the ISO 13408 series

blocks.zh: Part 6 隔離器：完全物理隔離，周圍環境可降至 Grade C；VHP 去污染需 BI 驗證；Amendment 1 強化殘留物和人員暴露要求
blocks.en: Part 6 Isolators: complete physical separation, with the surrounding environment able to drop to Grade C; VHP decontamination requires BI validation; Amendment 1 strengthens the requirements for residues and personnel exposure

blocks.zh: Part 7 替代製程：適用於傳統 Media Fill 不可行的醫療器材/組合產品；整體策略必須涵蓋所有無菌處理步驟；風險評估驅動模擬設計
blocks.en: Part 7 Alternative processes: applies to medical devices/combination products for which conventional media fill is not feasible; the overall strategy must cover all aseptic processing steps; risk assessment drives the design of the simulation

blocks.zh: 系列整合：Parts 1-7 構成完整的無菌製程保證框架，每部分解決特定技術問題，相互補充
blocks.en: Series integration: Parts 1-7 together form a complete framework for aseptic process assurance; each part addresses a specific technical issue and they complement one another

blocks.zh: 法規對齊：ISO 13408 系列與 EU GMP Annex 1、FDA 無菌處理指引、USP 章節高度對齊，是全球 sterile CDMO 合規的核心參考
blocks.en: Regulatory alignment: the ISO 13408 series is closely aligned with EU GMP Annex 1, the FDA aseptic processing guidance and USP chapters, and is a core reference for global sterile CDMO compliance

blocks.zh: CDMO 重點：每個客戶產品都需要完整的 ISO 13408 合規評估——從 APD 到 APS 到過濾驗證，每個環節都環環相扣
blocks.en: CDMO focus: every client product requires a complete ISO 13408 compliance assessment; from APD to APS to filtration validation, every element is interlinked
